goal: Replace the equipment simulator's user-facing static-sum or asynchronous SimC-gated attribute display with a versioned deterministic non-combat character-panel calculation that refreshes immediately after a confirmed gear change.
userValue: Players can trust that an imported community template and a manually adjusted gear combination show the same game-comparable base character attributes without waiting for a SimulationCraft job.
nonGoals: Do not model temporary combat buffs, consumables, trinket procs or other conditional effects as part of the non-combat base panel.
Do not remove, weaken or place SimulationCraft DPS, scenario simulation, queue, worker or audit behavior on the attribute-display path.
Do not change observed-only community-template eligibility, Resolver legality, Release/Manifest authority, enhancement capacity or canonical-selection rules.
Do not let the mini-program invent unresolved item variants, stable passives, source facts or rating conversion rules.

currentTruth.historicalBoundary: Existing Phase 5 asynchronous stat-snapshot evidence remains historical evidence for SimC execution and cache behavior; it cannot promote the new immediate-display claim.

mustChange: Backend-owned deterministic attribute-rule model and reference evaluator boundary.
Resolved gear payload or a dedicated read contract that supplies versioned attributeCalculationContext.
pages/builds/detail.* and workbench state so the immediate base panel consumes the deterministic result rather than SimC snapshot availability.
Frontend and backend golden-fixture parity tests, green-stat raw-plus-percent/effect presentation tests, and real mini-program performance evidence.
docs/builds-architecture.md and docs/gear-simulation-full-chain-runbook.md to document the post-cutover ownership and SimC boundary.
Winner-driven PostgreSQL attribute audit intent/worker/health boundary that is detached from Release promotion and player interactions.
mustNotChange: Resolver legality, canonical selection, observed-only community eligibility, Release/Manifest authority and enhancement constraints.
The existing gear_stat_snapshot SimC worker, queue, fencing and health semantics for simulation and audit purposes.
PG-only runtime and public-source trust boundaries.
Winner audit liveness, external official-profile availability and audit findings as prerequisites for any player-visible immediate attribute calculation.
riskUnknown: Verifiable rule sources for every first-release class/species/level/stable passive and all secondary-stat conversions.
Whether each Armory candidate captures the same equipment instances and time as its imported community template.
Exact non-combat treatment of niche stable set effects and avoidance, leech and speed display conversions.
evidenceRequired: Rule-source ledger and attributeRuleRevision for every formula admitted to the first release.
Cross-runtime fixtures proving the service reference evaluator and mini-program interpreter produce identical fields for a fixed canonical input.
Confirmed Frost and Arcane Armory golden samples with source URL, captured time, full gear/enhancement input and field-level expected output.
Real mini-program evidence that imported and manually assembled identical selections match and that p95 confirmed-change-to-panel-update is at most 100ms when context is available.
Candidate deployment evidence that SimC worker failure or cache miss does not block the immediate base panel, while simulation/audit status remains truthful.
Final local CR, candidate rollback proof and timer/backflow check.

ownership.factOwner: The backend WebSim Resolver and the versioned deterministic attribute-rule contract own character inputs, source facts, rule revisions and the server reference result. The mini-program is a consumer and local interpreter of that sealed context only.
consumers: equipment workbench state and community-template import replay
server-side reference validation and golden-sample audit
SimulationCraft scenario/DPS flows as a separate consumer of canonical gear inputs
server/attribute_rule_audit_store.py as sole owner of audit queue/result state
server/attribute_rule_audit_worker.py as read-only external-profile consumer after a sealed winner election
ownerMapRefs: docs/project-owner-map.json: WebSim gear/read-model and mini-program runtime domains

engineeringHealth.reason: The work crosses high-frequency pages/builds/detail.* and the server/websim_payload.py hotspot. Implementation must first characterize current static fallback, canonical selection, setData state replacement and SimC snapshot isolation; new arithmetic must live behind a narrow pure rule/evaluator boundary rather than route or page-event logic.

acceptanceEvidence: Targeted backend and frontend tests for fixed rule fixtures, rounding, incomplete context, all green-stat raw-plus-percent/effect display, and imported-versus-manual equality.
Cross-runtime parity fixture for the same attributeCalculationContext and attributeRuleRevision.
Golden-sample field-by-field comparison against confirmed Frost and Arcane Armory evidence.
Real mini-program performance trace and screenshots showing immediate base-panel refresh independent of SimC worker state.
Candidate deployment identity/parity, public payload/Resolver smoke, SimC isolation smoke, timer/backflow check and rollback rehearsal before merge.

decisionLog.decision: User confirmed the comparison target is the non-combat normal character panel: include level, race, stable specialization effects, confirmed gear, gems, enchants, embellishments and stable set effects; exclude temporary combat effects.

User approved the versioned rule-context approach: local deterministic display calculation with a backend reference evaluator, while SimC remains separate for simulation, complex conditional effects and audit.
User approved the Strict design contract and authorized progression to an implementation plan; no runtime implementation has started.

User approved implementation of the winner-driven audit as a fail-open background mechanism: audit failures, missing evidence and no published verified rule must never delay winner Release, community import, manual gear changes or SimC.
